name: RadioTile

props.name: checked
props.description: Specify whether the `RadioTile` should be checked.

props.name: decorator
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `decorator` component to be rendered inside the `RadioTile` component

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether the `RadioTile` should be disabled.

props.name: hasRoundedCorners
props.description: **Experimental**: Specify if the `ExpandableTile` component should be rendered with rounded corners. Only valid when `slug` prop is present

props.name: light
props.description: `true` to use the light version. For use on `$layer-01` backgrounds only. Don't use this to make tile background color the same as the container background color.

props.name: required
props.description: `true` to specify if the input is required.

props.name: slug
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `Slug` component to be rendered inside the `RadioTile` component

props.name: value
props.description: Specify the value of the underlying `<input>`.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon RadioTile rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
